title: singlecell-pipeline: single-nucleus multiome processing and QTL discovery in FinnGen
description: WDL workflows, container definitions, and helper scripts for processing single-nucleus multiome data (snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq) and for cis-QTL discovery and statistical fine-mapping in FinnGen.

creators.affiliation: Massachusetts General Hospital & Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
